name: Profile N+1 query pattern
description: A 'perf' task: identify N+1 query patterns in the task listing endpoint.
prompt: Profile the GET /api/projects/{id}/tasks endpoint for N+1 query patterns. Check: (1) Are task payloads loaded in a separate query per task? (2) Are context fields lazily loaded? (3) Is there an unbounded pagination issue? List each finding with file:line and estimated impact.
